content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was due to an unintended change in the calculation of packets per second (PPS) during the refactoring in commit 200b8079339c, which incorrectly disabled PPS calculation when the test time was less than 1 second. Additionally, the initial value for the `count` parameter was hardcoded as 1,000,000 instead of using the defined `DEFAULT_COUNT`, which could lead to inconsistent behavior in the initialization of flood parameters.
